core_principles: Calm by design: Wide open spaces, slow-paced interaction, distraction-free reading.
Editorial format: Text is paramount. Focus on long-form reading, similar to a high-end magazine.
No engagement traps: Strictly NO follower counts, trending tags, chat widgets, or exit-intent popups.
voice_and_tone: First-person singular from Pete ('I built this'). Direct second-person ('you' not 'the member').
Short sentences. Plain words. NO motivational hype.
Strictly NO em dashes or en dashes anywhere.

styling.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#2C2410]
styling.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#2C2410]
styling.body: font-serif text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-[#2C2410] max-w-prose

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. High white space. Content is centered and structured linearly.
layout_and_spacing.padding_scale: p-8 to p-24 for vertical rhythm
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid #E8D4A0 (Mid Gold) to separate feed items, NO heavy drop shadows. Flat surfaces only.

components.buttons: Flat, background #AD893E, text #FDFAF4, rounded-md, no shadow. Hover: slight opacity shift to 90%. Use data-testid.
components.inputs: Shadcn-based but customized. 1px solid #E8D4A0 border, #FDFAF4 background. Focus: ring-1 ring-[#AD893E].
components.feed_posts: Cardless layout. Posts separated by thin gold borders (border-b border-[#E8D4A0]) with ample vertical padding (py-12).
components.navigation: Minimalist header. Sticky top. Contains next release window timestamp in a subtle UI label. Background #FDFAF4/90 with backdrop-blur-md.

media_and_images.rules: No stock photography of teams. Only calm architecture, textures, and the Bloom mark.

brand_assets.logo_usage: 80-90px in hero, 28-36px in footer, 24-32px in top-left nav as home button.

hero_and_marketing.description: Minimalist interior architectural detail with golden hour light
Abstract serene background texture in cream and pale gold

testing_and_qa.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, and form inputs MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case and role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Plus Jakarta Sans and Georgia fonts into the application properly.
Follow the specific color palette exactly as specified in the colors section. Map them in tailwind.config.js.
Do NOT use standard shadow cards for the feed; use flat, spacious layouts with thin #E8D4A0 borders.
Ensure 'Next release window' logic displays exactly 8:30am or 5:30pm America/Chicago time in the UI.
Do not include any chat widgets, popups, or follower counts anywhere in the UI.
Strictly avoid em dashes and en dashes in all platform copy. Check hardcoded marketing copy.
Ensure the Bloom Mark SVG uses exactly the sizes defined (Hero: 80-90px, Nav: 24-32px, Footer: 28-36px).
